cron.name: Agent autopilot — drain agent queue every 30 min
Daily backlog hygiene — retire duplicates and review relevance
Daily morning plan — what you're going to do today
Daily evening recap — what did you get done today
One-time grading of work resolved before grading existed (manual)
Daily grading of drafts, suggestions and agent tasks by what happened
Continuous activity workflow miner every 60 min
iMessage extraction — surface follow-ups/events/links every 15 min
Inbox folder watcher (drop .md/.txt files for tasks)
Daily observation retention — prune expired capture, reclaim disk
Self-update (fast-forward + restart when a new version ships)
Auto-detect task completion / progress from screen
Task-list hygiene — dedupe / re-home / archive every 60 min
Weekly retrospective — roll up 7 daily retros
